verdict.rationale: Gram documents team/server/tool-level RBAC synced to enterprise IDPs, blocks unsanctioned shadow MCP servers by default, and MoonPay case study describes permissions scoped per server, per tool, and per team via Okta. Docs also show a catalog of approved tools provisioned by role/identity provider, giving concrete allowlist/per-tool access control mechanisms. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification beyond vendor docs and case study, and finer detail on tool-level allowlist UI/config granularity.
